snippet.title: 10 Best Places To visit In Ghana 2025
snippet.description:
#VisitGhana2025 #ExploreGhana #GhanaTravel
Ghana is a country rich in history, culture, and natural beauty, offering travelers an unforgettable experience in 2025. From historic forts to breathtaking landscapes, Ghana has something for everyone. In this video, we’ll take you through the 10 best places to visit in Ghana, highlighting the must-see destinations that will make your trip truly remarkable.10 Best Places To visit In Ghana 2025

Explore the poignant history at Cape Coast Castle and Elmina Castle, which played central roles in the transatlantic slave trade. Experience the beauty of Kakum National Park with its famous canopy walk, or immerse yourself in the cultural heart of Ghana in Accra. Whether you’re boating on Lake Volta, hiking to Wli Waterfalls, or experiencing the unique village of Nzulezo, Ghana offers diverse attractions that blend history, culture, and nature seamlessly.

Planning a trip to Ghana? Don’t forget to subscribe for more travel tips and guides. Let us know in the comments which of these amazing places you’re most excited to visit, and be sure to like this video if you’re ready to explore the beauty and history of Ghana!

snippet.title: La razón por la que rechazamos muchas colaboraciones
snippet.description:
Existe una parte del mundo influencer y de las colaboraciones comerciales que cada vez nos resulta más difícil entender.

No hablamos de cobrar por tu trabajo.

Eso nos parece completamente legítimo.

Hablamos de propuestas donde las recomendaciones dejan de basarse en el valor real del servicio y pasan a depender exclusivamente de una comisión.

Y todavía peor cuando esas comisiones se plantean fuera de cualquier factura o control fiscal.

En Lexborders tenemos una filosofía muy simple.

Si un producto o servicio puede ayudar a nuestros clientes, lo estudiamos.

Lo probamos.

Y si creemos que aporta valor, lo recomendaremos.

Pero no porque alguien nos pague una comisión.

Y mucho menos porque esa comisión deba esconderse.

Porque nuestra prioridad siempre será la misma.

Que la persona que confía en nosotros reciba el mejor servicio posible.

Y si además puede ahorrar dinero por el camino, mejor para ella.

👉 ¿Tú confiarías en una recomendación si supieras que quien la hace cobra por ella?

Yes!!!  but only under specific conditions. In this video, Sufyan Abroad explains how you can travel to Cyprus using your Pakistani passport if you hold a valid Schengen residence permit (TRC) or ID.

Requirement: Valid Schengen Residence Permit (TRC) or ID card
Other accepted visas/residence permits (EU countries, multiple-entry visas)
Entry rules and what immigration officers check
Required documents at the airport:
Valid passport
Residence permit / TRC / visa
Return ticket
Accommodation proof
Travel insurance
Duration of stay allowed

✔ Students & workers with Schengen residence permits
✔ Travelers planning a Cyprus trip from EU countries
✔ Digital nomads exploring visa-free options

Always check your permit validity and entry conditions before traveling

snippet.title: 📍 Cómo obtener certificado digital si todavía no tienes NIE asignado
snippet.description:
Muchas personas que quieren presentar por sí mismas la regularización masiva se encuentran con el mismo problema:

No tienen todavía NIE asignado y necesitan certificado digital.

Existen algunas vías que determinadas personas están utilizando para conseguir identificación previa.

Una de ellas consiste en solicitar una certificación negativa de nombre en el Registro Mercantil Central como paso previo a una hipotética constitución de empresa y utilizar eso para solicitar asignación de NIE.

Otra posibilidad es obtener un número identificativo fiscal a través de notaría mediante modelo 030, algo que algunos notarios tramitan directamente.

⚠️ Evidentemente cada caso puede funcionar de forma distinta según oficina, funcionario o notaría.

Y es importante recordar algo:

El NIE es permanente.

Lo que caduca es la autorización o el TIE, pero el número NIE permanece asociado a la persona durante toda la vida.

snippet.title: ATHENS, GREECE (2025) | 10 Historical Sights You Can’t Miss in Athens
snippet.description:
#AthensHistory2025 #AncientGreece #MustSeeInAthens
Athens, the cradle of Western civilization, offers a wealth of historical sites that will take you on an unforgettable journey through time. In 2025, the city remains one of the most captivating places for history lovers and cultural explorers alike. This video will guide you through the 10 historical sights you simply can't miss during your visit to Athens.

From the iconic Acropolis, with its ancient temples like the Parthenon, to the fascinating artifacts housed in the Acropolis Museum, you’ll discover the rich heritage that shaped the modern world. We’ll also explore the grandeur of the Temple of Olympian Zeus, the preserved ruins of the Ancient Agora, and the architectural beauty of Hadrian’s Arch. Whether you’re wandering the bustling Roman Agora or soaking in the views at the Temple of Poseidon, Athens promises an unparalleled historical experience.

If you’re planning a trip to Athens or just have a passion for ancient history, don’t forget to subscribe for more travel tips and insights. snippet.title: Do Brazilians Love Desi Food? | Low-Investment Business Idea in Brazil | Shawarma, BBQ & Sweets
snippet.description:
Do Brazilians Love Desi Food? Exploring Pakistani Shawarma, BBQ & Sweets in Brazil

Brazil is known for its rich food culture, diverse population, and love for delicious meals. But what happens when authentic Pakistani flavors arrive in the heart of Brazil?

During my recent visit to AAG BBQ in Brasília, I explored a growing Pakistani Desi food business that is introducing Brazilian customers to the taste of Pakistan. From juicy shawarma and smoky BBQ to traditional sweets like Gulab Jamun, Barfi, and Cake Rusk, the experience was both delicious and inspiring.

## A Taste of Pakistan in Brazil

For many Brazilians, Pakistani cuisine is still relatively new. However, the combination of flavorful spices, grilled meats, and unique desserts is attracting increasing attention.

AAG BBQ has become a place where locals and international visitors can enjoy authentic Desi food while learning more about Pakistani culture and hospitality. The menu offers a blend of traditional recipes and flavors that remind Pakistanis of home while giving Brazilians a new culinary experience.

## Shawarma, BBQ and Traditional Sweets

One of the highlights of the visit was the variety of food available.

The shawarma was packed with flavor, the BBQ was freshly grilled, and the traditional sweets added a perfect finishing touch. Gulab Jamun, Barfi, and Cake Rusk are popular favorites among South Asians, and it was exciting to see these items available in Brazil.

Food is one of the most powerful ways to connect cultures, and businesses like AAG BBQ are helping bridge the gap between Pakistan and Brazil.

## A Low-Investment Food Business Idea

Beyond the food itself, this story is also about entrepreneurship.

Many immigrants dream of starting a business abroad but are unsure where to begin. A food business can be a practical option because it allows entrepreneurs to share their culture while creating economic opportunities.

The success of Pakistani food businesses in Brazil demonstrates that with dedication, quality products, and good customer service, even a small investment can grow into a successful venture.

## Do Brazilians Love Desi Food?

The answer appears to be yes.

As more Brazilians discover Pakistani BBQ, shawarma, and sweets, interest continues to grow. People are curious about new flavors and enjoy experiencing different cultures through food.

The positive response shows that authentic Pakistani cuisine has the potential to become an even bigger part of Brazil's diverse food scene.

## Final Thoughts

My visit to AAG BBQ was more than just a food vlog. It was a chance to witness cultural exchange, entrepreneurship, and the growing popularity of Pakistani cuisine in Brazil.

Whether you are interested in food, business, travel, or cultural experiences, this story proves that great food can bring people together across continents.

From Pakistan to Brazil, Desi food is making its mark—one delicious bite at a time.

FAQs:
1. Which city is cheaper for digital nomads: Chiang Mai or Da Nang?
Both cities are affordable, but Chiang Mai is slightly cheaper overall. Accommodation, food, and transportation costs are lower in Chiang Mai, while Da Nang offers better value for beachfront living and modern amenities.

2. Which city has better coworking spaces?
Chiang Mai has a more established coworking scene with popular spaces like Punspace and CAMP. However, Da Nang is catching up quickly with modern spaces like DNCoffee and The V Space. Both cities offer reliable internet and a strong nomad community.

3. Is the internet speed reliable in Chiang Mai and Da Nang?
Yes, both cities have reliable internet. Chiang Mai averages around 30-50 Mbps, while Da Nang offers speeds of 40-60 Mbps. Da Nang has a slight edge in consistency, especially in newer coworking spaces.

4. Which city has a better expat community?
Chiang Mai has a larger and more established expat community, making it easier to network and find support. Da Nang has a growing community but is smaller and more laid-back, ideal for those seeking a quieter environment.

5. What’s the visa situation like in Chiang Mai vs Da Nang?
Chiang Mai (Thailand): Offers tourist visas (60 days, extendable) and long-term options like the Elite Visa or Education Visa.
Da Nang (Vietnam): Offers tourist visas (30 days, extendable) and business visas (up to 1 year) for remote workers. Both cities are nomad-friendly, but Vietnam’s visa process is slightly more straightforward.

6. Which city has better food options?
Chiang Mai: Known for its diverse street food, night markets, and Thai cuisine.
Da Nang: Offers a mix of Vietnamese street food, seafood, and international restaurants.
It’s a tie—both cities are foodie paradises!

7. Is Chiang Mai or Da Nang safer for digital nomads?
Both cities are very safe, with low crime rates. Chiang Mai is known for its friendly locals, while Da Nang is considered one of Vietnam’s safest cities. Petty theft is rare in both places.

8. Which city has better weather?
Chiang Mai: Has a tropical climate with a hot season (March-May), rainy season (June-October), and cool season (November-February).

Da Nang: Has a tropical monsoon climate with a dry season (February-May) and rainy season (September-January). Da Nang’s coastal location makes it more humid but offers beach-friendly weather year-round.

9. Which city is better for long-term stays?
Chiang Mai: Ideal for nomads who prefer a mountain vibe, lower costs, and a strong expat network.
Da Nang: Perfect for those who love the beach, modern infrastructure, and a quieter lifestyle.
It depends on your preferences!

10. Can I find good healthcare in Chiang Mai and Da Nang?
Yes, both cities have excellent healthcare options.
Chiang Mai: Has internationally accredited hospitals like Chiang Mai Ram Hospital.
Da Nang: Offers modern facilities like Family Medical Practice and Vinmec. Both cities are well-equipped for expats and nomads.

11. Which city has better transportation options?
Chiang Mai: Relies on tuk-tuks, songthaews (shared taxis), and motorbike rentals. Traffic can be congested.
Da Nang: Has a more organized system with Grab (ride-hailing), motorbike rentals, and fewer traffic issues. Da Nang is slightly easier to navigate.

snippet.title: ¿Puedo pasar de estudiante a Profesional Altamente Cualificado?
snippet.description:
Si tienes una estancia por estudios en España y además estás trabajando, existe una pregunta que deberías hacerte cuanto antes:

¿Tengo opciones para cambiar mi situación antes de terminar mis estudios?

Muchas personas creen que deben esperar obligatoriamente a finalizar la formación para estudiar otras autorizaciones.

Sin embargo, dependiendo del perfil profesional, la empresa contratante y los requisitos exigidos por la normativa, pueden existir alternativas como la autorización de Profesional Altamente Cualificado.

El problema es que muchas personas descubren estas opciones demasiado tarde.

Cuando la estancia está cerca de terminar.

Cuando ya han perdido oportunidades.

O cuando podrían haber preparado la transición con mucha más tranquilidad.

Por eso siempre insistimos en una idea:

La estrategia migratoria empieza mucho antes de que necesites el siguiente permiso.
